block.storagemerger.storage_linker.toolt: Merges the _Item Vaults_ and _Item Silos_ it touches into _one shared inventory_. Chain linkers together to join storages that are further apart.
Funnels, chutes and packagers on _any_ linked storage can reach _every_ linked storage. Items fill the storage they enter first, then spill over into the rest.
The storages split apart again. Items stay where they are.
